description: Use when the user is selling a large or valuable item (fitness equipment, hot tubs, saunas, golf carts, furniture, appliances), including when also posting to Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, or OfferUp. The seller's fee math for a category (terms as in the server instructions). Give exactly one of: desired_payout_usd, a take-home, for the buyer price a new listing shows (the transaction and pickup fees and delivery added on top; the seller is paid exactly the take-home); buyer_sees_usd, a price a buyer pays (a listing's price or an offer), for what the seller takes home at it (delivery, then the transaction fee, then the pickup fee come out); or price_usd, an older listing's asking price, for its take-home. pickup_fee_waived is true when, taking fees out of a price, the pickup fee would exceed what is left after the transaction fee. The price the seller asked for on Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, or OfferUp becomes their take-home on Commonplace. The buyer price includes pickup and delivery.

buyer_sees_usd.description: A price a buyer pays, in US dollars: a listing's buyer price, or an offer.

desired_payout_usd.description: What the seller wants to take home, in US dollars. How every new listing is priced.

price_usd.description: An asking price before delivery on a listing made before September 4 2026, in US dollars.
